tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Page background (body bg-white) and text on dark gradient cards. Tailwind's built-in white.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Body text (body text-black) on white, 21:1. Tailwind's built-in black.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Subtle surface and the lightest hairline (border-gray-100 on the about cards). Folds in gray-50.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: THE hairline: card and row dividers (border-t on news rows), hover fill on light chips.

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Muted text on dark grounds: dates, eyebrows, dark chips. 9:1+ on graphite-900, 14:1 on black.

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, chips: 4.8:1, replaces gray-400 at 2.6:1), meta text on white (dates, news type: replaces gray-400), chip border on dark, image placeholder.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white: chip labels, roles, captions (7.6:1). Folds in gray-700.

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: Strong neutral text: chip hover label, emphasis inside muted blocks (14.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-50
tokens.usage: Tint for highlighted panels and hover backgrounds.

tokens.name: accent-100
tokens.usage: Light tint behind accent content.

tokens.name: accent-200
tokens.usage: Soft tint; borders on accent-tinted surfaces.

tokens.name: accent-300
tokens.usage: Hover for accent text on dark grounds (accent-text-on-dark-hover). 6.9:1 on graphite-900.

tokens.name: accent-400
tokens.usage: Accent text and links on ANY dark ground (accent-text-on-dark): 4.8:1 on graphite-900, 7.6:1 on black.

tokens.name: accent-500
tokens.usage: The bright brand red: data highlights, the stripe on dark cards, the cover. Not for text: 3.7:1 on white, 3.6:1 on graphite.

tokens.name: accent-600
tokens.usage: The brand red as a FILL: the 4px accent stripe, input focus border, icons, decorative blocks. Not for small text: 4.55:1 on white falls to 4.0:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent-700
tokens.usage: Accent text and links on light grounds, and the fill behind white text (accent-text, accent-fill): 6.2:1 on white, 5.5:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent-800
tokens.usage: Hover for accent text and fills on light grounds: 8.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-900
tokens.usage: Darkest working red; text on accent tints. Not a background: dark grounds are graphite.

tokens.name: accent-950
tokens.usage: Near-black red; deepest shade of the scale. Not a background: dark grounds are graphite.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent words on white, gray-100 and surface-alt; primary button label. 6.2:1 on white, 5.5:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent-text-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text-on-dark
tokens.usage: Links and accent words on black, graphite and the dark gradients, at every size. Replaces text-accent-500 and text-accent-600 on dark.

tokens.name: accent-text-on-dark-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for accent-text-on-dark (or go to white).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Solid red behind white text: filled buttons, badges, the current page in pagination, menu hover. White on it is 6.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-stripe
tokens.usage: The 4px stripe beside cards and other non-text red marks on light grounds (3:1 needed, 4.55:1 given).

tokens.name: graphite-900
tokens.usage: THE secondary and THE dark ground: the end of every dark gradient (page headers, heroes, CTAs, dark cards) and the dropdown menu. White text 13.2:1.

tokens.name: graphite-800
tokens.usage: Lighter graphite: the low end of the data ramp; dark panels and chart ink on white (11:1).

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: The light grey that sections fade into (from-white to-[#F0F0F0] under team, keyword and project pages). Quiet alternate section background.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Data ramp, step 1 (lowest): the home hero's population ramp starts in graphite.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Data ramp, step 2: graphite turning red. Data only, never a background.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Data ramp, step 3: deep red.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Data ramp, step 4: bright brand red (#f73c49).

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Data ramp, step 5 (highest): pale pink, reads on dark grounds.

tokens.name: bg-gradient-start
tokens.usage: Start of the dark page/hero gradient (written 'black' in the source).

tokens.name: bg-gradient-end
tokens.usage: End of every dark gradient: graphite (was wine #63121f). Black → graphite is the site's dark ground; white text 13.2:1.

tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: The red of the logo and favicon mark (dot plot). Used only inside the marks; for UI red use accent-600.

tokens.name: logo-red-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary red in the logo artwork's boxplot detail. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The logo's near-black wordmark ink. Logo only; on dark grounds the full logo needs a light backing.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero h1 at xl (text-7xl leading-tight).
styles.sample: Analytics, research, and data visualisation that make a difference.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page h1 at lg (text-6xl leading-tight); also section titles on the about page.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Large section h2 at lg (text-5xl leading-tight).

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: h1 on small screens; section h2 at lg (text-3xl).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body and prose (text-base; .prose is pinned to 1rem).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags and small headings (text-sm font-semibold).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Card excerpts and metadata (text-sm) — the most used size on the site.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px. Hairline gaps: chip vertical padding (py-1), icon-to-text, stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px. Button vertical padding (py-2), chip horizontal padding (px-2), gaps inside chip rows (gap-2), heading-to-list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px. THE base step: card padding on small screens (p-4), button horizontal padding (px-4), small grid gutter (gap-4), mobile header gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px. Block spacing inside a card at lg (mt-6) and between a card's sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px. Page gutter (px-8), card padding at lg (p-8), panel and page-header padding (p-8), medium grid gutter (gap-8).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 48px. Large grid gutter (gap-12), space below a page h1 (pb-12), section padding on mobile (py-12).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: 96px. Section padding (pt-24 / pb-24) and the gap between a page's two main columns at lg (gap-24).

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: 144px. Hero and landing sections at lg only (lg:py-36).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: 4px. The ONLY corner: cards, buttons, chips, inputs, menus, images in cards (Tailwind `rounded`). Replaces rounded-lg.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars (h-12 w-12) and the thin accent bars. Never on buttons or cards.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting elevation for everything on the page: cards, buttons, avatars, page headers (Tailwind `shadow`, identical to `shadow-sm` in v4).

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hover lift for clickable cards only (hover:shadow-md).

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float above the page: the sticky header and the dropdown menu (shadow-lg). Not for content images.

tokens.name: container-content
tokens.usage: 1152px. Max width of every content column (max-w-(--container-content) mx-auto). Not "container-max": in Tailwind that key would redefine w-max.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the site header (--header-height).

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every border: cards, chips, buttons, inputs, dividers.

tokens.name: stripe-width
tokens.usage: The accent stripe beside cards (.accent-stripe, w-1).

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: 44px. Minimum height of buttons (min-h-11).
